_comment: Pet rules (Phase 10, DESIGN section 11). One pet is active at a time; the others wait in your stable. Pets are your level. fed drops by hungerPerHour (real time); below hungry they hit for hungryDamage and won't carry you. Food items and how much they feed are in food. Taming: interact with a tameable creature while carrying its food (one is eaten), then win the trust game: hit the moving marker inside the zone `hits` times before missing `misses` times. Rare pets come from their Beastkeeper quest and mini boss, legendary ones from a Bond Trial after their world boss.
